programme.title: Od jutra do sutra / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Feride je razočarana što je Aziz ne prepoznaje, ali je odlučila biti strpljiva i ne odustati od Aziza. Hasibe dolazi kod Tahsina i traži od njega da mu izbavi sina iz zatvora. Emine je zabrinuta za Jalčina i čeka ga ispred policijske stanice. Uloge: Kadir Doğulu, Devrim Özkan, Ümit Kantarcılar, Onur Seyit Yaran, Gozde Kaya, Pelin Uluksar, Mehmet Ozgur Režija: Murat Onbul

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V / Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V
programme.desc: The animated series follows the exciting adventures of the daring boy Yuya Sakaki, whose father disappeared three years ago. The boy's big dream is to follow in his father's footsteps and become a top duelist. After he unexpectedly discovers a new technique for summoning monsters, that dream slowly begins to become his reality. / Animirana serija prati uzbudljive avanture odvažnog dječaka Yuye Sakakija, čiji je otac nestao prije tri godine. Dječakov veliki san je poći očevim stopama i postati vrhunski duelist. Nakon što nenadano otkrije novu tehniku za prizivanje čudovišta, taj san polako počinje biti njegova stvarnost.

programme.title: Mummies / Mumijevi
programme.desc: They are apparently an ordinary family.. they look like hippos and live in the Valley of the Mummies. They bring numerous ordinary and unusual adventures, both at home and on trips and excursions, where they meet various interesting beings and persons. / Oni su naizgled obična porodica.. liče na nilske konje i žive u dolini Mumijeva. Oni donose brojne obične i neobične dogodovštine, kako u kući, tako i na putovanjima i izletima, gdje upoznaju razna interesantna bića i osobe.

programme.title: Slugterra / Slugterra
programme.desc: Fifteen-year-old Eli Shane's life is ordinary, except for one thing. He comes from the Shane family. Each member of that family traveled to the underworld of Slugterra to protect the special world of slugs. Now it's Eli's turn to visit the underworld and protect it from the enemy, whether he's ready or not. Eli is determined to become a hero in order to resist the forces of evil. Together with his friends Trixie, Korda and Pronto, he must carefully collect and train small animals, different snails, which have the ability to transform into magical monsters. / Petnaestogodišnjem Eliju Shaneu je u životu sve obično, osim jedne stvari. Dolazi iz porodice Shane. Svaki član te porodice putovao je u podzemlje Slugterre, kako bi zaštitio posebni svijet slug-ova. Sada je red na Elija, da posjeti podzemlje i da ga zaštiti od neprijatelja, bio on spreman ili ne. Eli je ustrajan u namjeri da postane heroj, kako bi se uspio oduprijeti silama zla. Zajedno sa prijateljima Trixie, Kordom i Prontom mora pažljivo sakupljati i trenirati male životinje, različite puževe, koji imaju sposobnost transformirati se u magična čudovišta.

programme.title: Victims of love / Žrtve ljubavi
programme.desc: Count Farnesi decides to help Brando's family, which is in big trouble. Lucrezia's brother Livio did not take it well, because he considers them peasants and Brando unworthy of his sister's love. Maddalena goes to Villa Corradi to ask Silvia for an explanation. After the initial embarrassment, Mrs. Corradi speaks openly with Brando's sister and reveals to her the real reasons why she could not acquit Maddalena of the charge of theft. In addition, she asks Maddalena not to reveal to Brando how much she has sacrificed for love, because it is better that he still hates her. Count Volpi visits Leopold Corradi and condemns him for not helping Albert in his political struggles. During a heated discussion, Goffredo reveals to Leopold the shocking fact that Alessandro is the son of the venerable mother Agnes! Maddalena is convinced that Brando needs to find out the truth about Silvia and goes to Des Alpes with the intention of revealing everything to him. But there she encounters a situation that may force her to change her plan. Cast: Francesca Valtorta, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree Nofereini, Federica De Benedittis / Grof Farnesi odlučuje pomoći Brandovoj obitelji koja je u velikim problemima. Lucrezijin brat Livio to nije dobro prihvatio, jer on ih smatra seljacima, a Branda nevrijednim ljubavi njegove sestre. Maddalena odlazi u vilu Corradi kako bi Silviju zamolila za objašnjenje. Nakon prvobitne neugode, gđa Corradi otvoreno razgovara sa Brandovom sestrom i otkriva joj stvarne razloge zašto nije mogla Maddalenu osloboditi optužbe za krađu. Osim toga, zamoli Maddalenu da ne otkrije Brandu koliko se žrtvovala za ljubav, jer je bolje da je on i dalje mrzi. Leopoldu Corradiju u posjet dolazi grof Volpi, i osuđuje ga što nije pomogao Albertu u političkim borbama. Tokom žustre rasprave, Goffredo otkriva Leopoldu šokantnu činjenicu, da je Alessandro sin časne majke Agnese! Maddalena je uvjerena da Brando treba saznati istinu o Silviji te odlazi u Des Alpes s namjerom da mu sve otkrije. No tamo zatekne situaciju koja će je možda nagnati da promijeni svoj plan. Uloge: Francesca Valtorta, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree Nofereini, Federica De Benedittis

Kroz aktuelne vijesti, analize, razgovore sa ekspertima, emisija daje sveobuhvatnu sliku savremenih ekonomskih kretanja i uvid u tržište Bosne i Hercegovine.

programme.title: Victims of love / Žrtve ljubavi
programme.desc: Maddalena comes to Brando, but when she sees him happily holding hands with Countess Farnesi, she decides to withhold the truth about the sacrifice Silvia had to make to save him. She tells her brother that both she and her father have found new jobs. Brando realizes that Lucrezia is responsible for the help her family has received. When the two are alone, Brando asks her about Silvia, but Maddalena tells him that Silvia is fine. Brando admits that his love for Silvia has turned to hatred and that his heart now belongs to Lucrezia. Leopoldo Corradi is furious when he discovers that Alessandro Lucchesi is the fruit of a relationship he had as a young man with the venerable mother Agnese. After the hospital refused to pay the expenses for Professor Forlanini's seminar, Dr. Lucchesi began to think about leaving the Holy Crown, despite the insistence of Reverend Mother Agnes, who begged him to stay. In order not to lose him, Agnese offered him the position of head of the hospital. Tommaso intends to clarify everything with Queen Jelena and decides to go to lunch without Carlotta. But Carlotta still appears and introduces herself again as his fiancée, then repents and returns to the queen to confess the whole truth to her. Cast: Francesca Valtorta, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree Nofereini, Federica De Benedittis / Maddalena dolazi kod Branda, ali kada ga vidi sretnog kako se drži ruku pod ruku s groficom Farnesi, odluči zatajiti istinu o žrtvi koju je Silvija morala podnijeti kako bi ga spasila. Govori bratu da su i ona i otac pronašli novi posao. Brando shvati da je Lucrezia zaslužna za pomoć koju je njezina obitelj primila. Kad njih dvoje ostanu nasamo, Brando je pita za Silviju, no Maddalena mu slaže da je Silvija dobro. Brando priznaje da se njegova ljubav prema Silviji pretvorila u mržnju i da njegovo srce sada pripada Lucreziji. Leopoldo Corradi je bijesan kada otkrije da je Alessandro Lucchesi plod veze koju je kao mladić imao s časnom majkom Agnese. Nakon što je bolnica odbila platiti troškove za seminar profesora Forlaninija, dr. Lucchesi počne razmišljati o odlasku iz Svete Krune, unatoč insistiranju časne majke Agnese, koja ga preklinje da ostane. Kako ga ne bi izgubila, Agnese mu ponudi mjesto šefa bolnice. Tommaso namjerava sve razjasniti s kraljicom Jelenom i odluči otići na ručak bez Carlotte. No Carlotta se ipak pojavi i predstavi se ponovno kao njegova zaručnica, potom se pokaje i vrati kod kraljice kako bi joj priznala cijelu istinu. Uloge: Francesca Valtorta, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree Nofereini, Federica De Benedittis

programme.title: Three mace / Tri mace
programme.desc: Animated series for the youngest about the adventures of three fearless kittens who are always ready for new challenges. The cheerful kitten Keksić lives with his big brother Čoka and little sister Lola. Their days are filled with fun and spending time with their best friends. They like to play, eat sweets, and explore unknown phenomena and objects that surround them. Every day they embark on a new adventure, and thanks to the wise advice of their caring parents, they overcome all obstacles and learn numerous life lessons. / Animirana serija za najmlađe o pustolovinama tri neustrašiva mačića koji su uvijek spremni za nove izazove. Veseli mačić Keksić živi s velikim bratom Čokom i malenom sestrom Lolom. Njihovi dani ispunjeni su zabavom i druženjem s najboljim prijateljima. Vole se igrati, jesti slatkiše, te istraživati nepoznate pojave i predmete koji ih okružuju. Svaki dan upuštaju se u novu pustolovinu, a zahvaljujući mudrim savjetima njihovih brižnih roditelja, rješavaju sve prepreke i uče brojne životne lekcije.

programme.title: Don't leave me / Ne ostavljaj me
programme.desc: Elena agrees with Dr. Misuri that she will leave the CNCPO, after solving the Gilbert Ballarino case, to join the Counter-Terrorist Service. She returns to Venice with the authority to form a task force with Daniele and other agents to launch an investigation. Elena and Daniele discover that Gilberto has been talking to the girl's fake profile, behind which his kidnapper is hiding, and that they have arranged a meeting. Meanwhile, a boy kidnapped and captured in the Polesina area tries to escape, but is arrested. Cast: Vittiria Puccini, Sarah Felberbaum, Duccio Gallorini, Massimo Rigo, Sergio Albelli, Maurizio Lombardi Director: Leonardo Fasoli, Maddalena Ravagli / Elena se slaže s dr. Misuri da će napustiti CNCPO, nakon što riješi slučaj Gilberta Ballarina, kako bi se pridružila Protuterorističkoj službi. Vraća se u Veneciju s ovlaštenjem da formira radnu grupu s Danieleom i drugim agentima kako bi pokrenula istragu. Elena i Daniele otkrivaju da je Gilberto razgovarao s lažnim profilom djevojke, a iza kojeg se krije njegov otmičar, i da su dogovorili sastanak. U međuvremenu, dječak otet i zarobljen u području Polesine pokušava pobjeći, ali biva uhapšen. Uloge: Vittiria Puccini, Sarah Felberbaum, Duccio Gallorini, Massimo Rigo, Sergio Albelli, Maurizio Lombardi Režija: Leonardo Fasoli, Maddalena Ravagli

programme.title: A game of fate / Igra sudbine
programme.desc: In his shop, Faik discovers a secret door leading to the basement. Nehir tells Serpil that a new employee has taken her place. Abdullah hands the flower to Ferida, and only she knows that it is the flower of hope. Kerem and Firat appear at the door and Hasibe is overjoyed. There is a meeting of the Board of Directors and everyone expresses their support for Sultan. Kerem and Firat try to clarify the situation in which they found themselves. Nehir promises Tahsin that he will get him the original documents, which are important to him. Sultan misses Aziz a lot. The doctor tells Tahsin that Aziz has woken up from a coma. Nehir is overjoyed. Feride cries and goes home from the hospital sad, because Aziz can't remember who she is. Cast: Kadir Doğulu, Devrim Özkan, Ümit Kantarcılar, Onur Seyit Yaran, Gozde Kaya, Pelin Uluksar, Mehmet Ozgur Director: Murat Onbul / Faik u svojoj radnji otkrije tajna vrata koja vode u podrum. Nehir govori Serpil da je na njeno mjesto došla nova uposlenica. Abdulah predaje cvijet Feride, a samo ona zna da je to cvijet nade. Kerem i Firat se pojavljuju na vratima i Hasibe je presretna zbog toga. Sastanak je Upravnog odbora i svi izražavaju podršku Sultan. Kerem i Firat pokušavaju razjasniti situaciju u kojoj su se našli. Nehir obećava Tahsinu da će mu pribaviti originalne dokumente, koji su mu važni. Sultan mnogo nedostaje Aziz. Doktor javlja Tahsinu da se Aziz probudio iz kome. Nehir je presretna. Feride plače i tužna odlazi kući iz bolnice, jer se Aziz ne može sjetiti ko je ona. Uloge: Kadir Doğulu, Devrim Özkan, Ümit Kantarcılar, Onur Seyit Yaran, Gozde Kaya, Pelin Uluksar, Mehmet Ozgur Režija: Murat Onbul

The boy's big dream is to follow in his father's footsteps and become a top duelist. After he unexpectedly discovers a new technique for summoning monsters, that dream slowly begins to become his reality. / Animirana serija prati uzbudljive avanture odvažnog dječaka Yuye Sakakija, čiji je otac nestao prije tri godine. Dječakov veliki san je poći očevim stopama i postati vrhunski duelist. Nakon što nenadano otkrije novu tehniku za prizivanje čudovišta, taj san polako počinje biti njegova stvarnost.

programme.title: Mummies / Mumijevi
programme.desc: They are apparently an ordinary family.. they look like hippos and live in the Valley of the Mummies. They bring numerous ordinary and unusual adventures, both at home and on trips and excursions, where they meet various interesting beings and persons. / Oni su naizgled obična porodica.. liče na nilske konje i žive u dolini Mumijeva. Oni donose brojne obične i neobične dogodovštine, kako u kući, tako i na putovanjima i izletima, gdje upoznaju razna interesantna bića i osobe.

programme.title: Slugterra / Slugterra
programme.desc: Fifteen-year-old Eli Shane's life is ordinary, except for one thing. He comes from the Shane family. Each member of that family traveled to the underworld of Slugterra to protect the special world of slugs. Now it's Eli's turn to visit the underworld and protect it from the enemy, whether he's ready or not. Eli is determined to become a hero in order to resist the forces of evil. Together with his friends Trixie, Korda and Pronto, he must carefully collect and train small animals, different snails, which have the ability to transform into magical monsters. / Petnaestogodišnjem Eliju Shaneu je u životu sve obično, osim jedne stvari. Dolazi iz porodice Shane. Svaki član te porodice putovao je u podzemlje Slugterre, kako bi zaštitio posebni svijet slug-ova. Sada je red na Elija, da posjeti podzemlje i da ga zaštiti od neprijatelja, bio on spreman ili ne. Eli je ustrajan u namjeri da postane heroj, kako bi se uspio oduprijeti silama zla. Zajedno sa prijateljima Trixie, Kordom i Prontom mora pažljivo sakupljati i trenirati male životinje, različite puževe, koji imaju sposobnost transformirati se u magična čudovišta.

programme.title: Victims of love / Žrtve ljubavi
programme.desc: Maddalena comes to Brando, but when she sees him happily holding hands with Countess Farnesi, she decides to withhold the truth about the sacrifice Silvia had to make to save him. She tells her brother that both she and her father have found new jobs. Brando realizes that Lucrezia is responsible for the help her family has received. When the two are alone, Brando asks her about Silvia, but Maddalena tells him that Silvia is fine. Brando admits that his love for Silvia has turned to hatred and that his heart now belongs to Lucrezia. Leopoldo Corradi is furious when he discovers that Alessandro Lucchesi is the fruit of a relationship he had as a young man with the venerable mother Agnese. After the hospital refused to pay the expenses for Professor Forlanini's seminar, Dr. Lucchesi began to think about leaving the Holy Crown, despite the insistence of Reverend Mother Agnes, who begged him to stay. In order not to lose him, Agnese offered him the position of head of the hospital. Tommaso intends to clarify everything with Queen Jelena and decides to go to lunch without Carlotta. But Carlotta still appears and introduces herself again as his fiancée, then repents and returns to the queen to confess the whole truth to her. Cast: Francesca Valtorta, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree Nofereini, Federica De Benedittis / Maddalena dolazi kod Branda, ali kada ga vidi sretnog kako se drži ruku pod ruku s groficom Farnesi, odluči zatajiti istinu o žrtvi koju je Silvija morala podnijeti kako bi ga spasila. Govori bratu da su i ona i otac pronašli novi posao. Brando shvati da je Lucrezia zaslužna za pomoć koju je njezina obitelj primila. Kad njih dvoje ostanu nasamo, Brando je pita za Silviju, no Maddalena mu slaže da je Silvija dobro. Brando priznaje da se njegova ljubav prema Silviji pretvorila u mržnju i da njegovo srce sada pripada Lucreziji. Leopoldo Corradi je bijesan kada otkrije da je Alessandro Lucchesi plod veze koju je kao mladić imao s časnom majkom Agnese. Nakon što je bolnica odbila platiti troškove za seminar profesora Forlaninija, dr. Lucchesi počne razmišljati o odlasku iz Svete Krune, unatoč insistiranju časne majke Agnese, koja ga preklinje da ostane. Kako ga ne bi izgubila, Agnese mu ponudi mjesto šefa bolnice. Tommaso namjerava sve razjasniti s kraljicom Jelenom i odluči otići na ručak bez Carlotte. No Carlotta se ipak pojavi i predstavi se ponovno kao njegova zaručnica, potom se pokaje i vrati kod kraljice kako bi joj priznala cijelu istinu. Uloge: Francesca Valtorta, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree Nofereini, Federica De Benedittis

programme.title: Mostar Blues and Rock Festival / Mostar Blues and Rock Festival
programme.desc: This year's edition of the Mostar Blues And Rock Festival brought top performances by local and foreign artists, but also a recognizable atmosphere that has made Mostar one of the most important musical centers of the region for years. We recorded for you the energy of the festival, conversations with musicians and organizers, along with authentic scenes from concerts that confirm that Mostar still plays its recognizable rhythm - the rhythm of freedom, togetherness and music that connects. / Ovogodišnje izdanje Mostar Blues And Rock festivala donijelo je vrhunske nastupe domaćih i stranih izvođača, ali i prepoznatljivu atmosferu koja Mostar već godinama čini jednim od najvažnijih muzičkih središta regije. Za vas smo zabilježili energiju festivala, razgovore sa muzičarima i organizatorima, uz autentične prizore s koncerata koji potvrđuju da Mostar i dalje svira svoj prepoznatljivi ritam _ ritam slobode, zajedništva i muzike koja povezuje.

programme.title: BH gastro corner / BH gastro kutak
programme.desc: With the culinary show "BH Gastro Kutak", get inspired by traditional dishes and tastes that will make your teeth grow. / Uz kulinarsku emisiju "BH gastro kutak" inspirišite se tradicionalnim jelima i okusima od kojih rastu zazubice.

programme.title: New adventure / Nova avantura
programme.desc: The show "New Adventure" shows the most significant archaeological discoveries in Bosnia and Herzegovina. / Emisija "Nova avantura" prikazuje najznačajnija arheološka otkrića na području Bosne i Hercegovine.

programme.title: News / Vijesti
programme.desc: The latest information from the country and the world. Daily review of the most important political, economic, social and cultural events. / Najnovije informacije iz zemlje i svijeta. Dnevni pregled najvažnijih političkih, ekonomskih, društvenih i kulturnih događaja.

programme.title: Global / Global
programme.desc: The program "Global" focuses on foreign policy topics discussed by experts from various fields. / Emisija "Global" u središte stavlja vanjskopolitičke teme o kojima govore eksperti iz različitih oblasti.

programme.title: Don't leave me / Ne ostavljaj me
programme.desc: Elena agrees with Dr. Misuri that she will leave the CNCPO, after solving the Gilbert Ballarino case, to join the Counter-Terrorist Service. She returns to Venice with the authority to form a task force with Daniele and other agents to launch an investigation. Elena and Daniele discover that Gilberto has been talking to the girl's fake profile, behind which his kidnapper is hiding, and that they have arranged a meeting. Meanwhile, a boy kidnapped and captured in the Polesina area tries to escape, but is arrested. Cast: Vittiria Puccini, Sarah Felberbaum, Duccio Gallorini, Massimo Rigo, Sergio Albelli, Maurizio Lombardi Director: Leonardo Fasoli, Maddalena Ravagli / Elena se slaže s dr. Misuri da će napustiti CNCPO, nakon što riješi slučaj Gilberta Ballarina, kako bi se pridružila Protuterorističkoj službi. Vraća se u Veneciju s ovlaštenjem da formira radnu grupu s Danieleom i drugim agentima kako bi pokrenula istragu. Elena i Daniele otkrivaju da je Gilberto razgovarao s lažnim profilom djevojke, a iza kojeg se krije njegov otmičar, i da su dogovorili sastanak. U međuvremenu, dječak otet i zarobljen u području Polesine pokušava pobjeći, ali biva uhapšen. Uloge: Vittiria Puccini, Sarah Felberbaum, Duccio Gallorini, Massimo Rigo, Sergio Albelli, Maurizio Lombardi Režija: Leonardo Fasoli, Maddalena Ravagli

programme.title: BHT 1 live / BHT 1 uživo
programme.desc: The motto of the BHT 1 live show is "News plus". In the show, information, analysis, predictions and the background of the event. Experts, analysts and citizens speak live for BHT 1. Comments on what is being talked about on social networks, and analysis of the topic of the day. Part of the content of the show are reports about lesser-known places, but also stories about beautiful and unusual regions of our country, and valuable and interesting people. / Moto emisije BHT 1 uživo je "Vijest plus". U emisiji informacije, analize, predviđanja i pozadina događaja. Za BHT 1 uživo govore stručnjaci, analitičari i građani. Komentari o čemu se priča na društvenim mrežama, i analiza teme dana. Dio sadržaja emisije su i reportaže o manje poznatim mjestima, ali i priče o lijepim i neobičnim predjelima naše zemlje, te vrijednim i zanimljivim ljudima.

programme.title: Victims of love / Žrtve ljubavi
programme.desc: Alberto remembers Lucchesi's words and decides to look for his daughter again. Because of this, he blackmails the venerable mother Agnes. In order not to have to reveal his real origin to Alessandra, she confesses to Corradio that his daughter is in an orphanage in Rufina and that he will recognize her by the tattoo on her neck. Alberto finds the little girl and takes her with him. An explosion occurs on the rails that transport marble, which angers the entrepreneurs. They are convinced that Leopoldo is responsible for it. Silvija goes to the wives of the miners in the quarry to persuade them that their husbands agree to work on the construction of the new railway, from which they will also benefit. Corrada is happy that his wife has a reason to live again, so he supports her in her endeavors and tears her confession of adultery. Lucrezia finds out that she is pregnant, and Brando welcomes the news with joy, but unfortunately, Dr. Riga will spoil his happiness. Cast: Francesca Valtorta, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree Nofereini, Federica De Benedittis / Alberto se prisjeća Lucchesijevih riječi i odluči ponovno potražiti svoju kćerku. Zbog toga ucijeni časnu majku Agnese. Da ne bi morala otkriti Alessandru njegovo stvarno podrijetlo, prizna Corradiju da je njegova kći u sirotištu u Rufini i da će je prepoznati po tetovaži na vratu. Alberto pronalazi djevojčicu i povede je sa sobom. Na tračnicama kojima se transportuje mramor dogodi se eksplozija, što naljuti poduzetnike. Uvjereni su da je Leopoldo odgovoran za to. Silvija odlazi ženama kopača iz kamenoloma kako bi ih nagovorila da njihovi muževi pristanu raditi na gradnji nove pruge, od čega će oni također imati koristi. Corrada veseli što njegova žena ponovno ima razloga za život, pa je podržava u njezinim pothvatima i podere njezino priznanje preljuba. Lucrezia saznaje da je trudna, a Brando tu vijest dočeka s veseljem, no nažalost, dr. Riga će pokvariti njegovu sreću. Uloge: Francesca Valtorta, Giorgio Lupano, Rocco Giusti, Desiree Nofereini, Federica De Benedittis

programme.title: Three mace / Tri mace
programme.desc: Animated series for the youngest about the adventures of three fearless kittens who are always ready for new challenges. The cheerful kitten Keksić lives with his big brother Čoka and little sister Lola. Their days are filled with fun and spending time with their best friends. They like to play, eat sweets, and explore unknown phenomena and objects that surround them. Every day they embark on a new adventure, and thanks to the wise advice of their caring parents, they overcome all obstacles and learn numerous life lessons. / Animirana serija za najmlađe o pustolovinama tri neustrašiva mačića koji su uvijek spremni za nove izazove. Veseli mačić Keksić živi s velikim bratom Čokom i malenom sestrom Lolom. Njihovi dani ispunjeni su zabavom i druženjem s najboljim prijateljima. Vole se igrati, jesti slatkiše, te istraživati nepoznate pojave i predmete koji ih okružuju. Svaki dan upuštaju se u novu pustolovinu, a zahvaljujući mudrim savjetima njihovih brižnih roditelja, rješavaju sve prepreke i uče brojne životne lekcije.

programme.title: Fundus / Fundus
programme.desc: "Fundus" is a format of TV stories whose themes are Bosnia and Herzegovina. cultural and historical heritage, unknown stories and details from our heritage, but also a reminder of the valuable cultural treasures kept by museums throughout the country. The best promotion of the country is through its rich and diverse culture. Museum depots store thousands of valuable objects and exhibits, among which are numerous world rarities. Collections are in no way behind the settings in prestigious European and world museums. With this form, BHRT wants to present them to the general public and remind them of their value. The stories cover only the basic and most interesting details, with the aim of encouraging viewers to visit the museums and institutions where the exhibits are located for more information. In Fundus, you will see interesting things that you did not know until now, objects that you have not seen before, and it will also present a part of the tradition about which there is no recorded information. / "Fundus" je format TV priča čije su teme bh. kulturno-historijsko naslijeđe, nepoznate priče i detalji iz naše baštine, ali i podsjećanje na vrijedno kulturno blago koje čuvaju muzeji širom zemlje. Najbolja promocija države je preko njene bogate i raznovrsne kulture. Muzejski depoi čuvaju hiljade vrijednih predmeta i eksponata, među kojima su brojni svjetski rariteti. Kolekcije i zbirke ni po čemu ne zaostaju za postavkama u uglednim evropskim i svjetskim muzejima. Ovom formom BHRT želi da ih predstavi široj javnosti i podsjeti na njihovu vrijednost. Priče obrađuju samo osnovne i najzanimljivije detalje, s ciljem da potaknu gledatelje da za više informacija posjete muzeje i ustanove u kojima se nalaze eksponati. U Fundusu ćete vidjeti zanimljivosti koje do sada niste znali, predmete koje niste prije vidjeli, a predstaviće i dio tradicije o kojoj nema zabilježenih informacija.

programme.title: Countdown / Odbrojavanje
programme.desc: In the political magazine, the promotion of the culture of dialogue, and about current topics of socio-political reality. Credible guests present their, often opposing, opinions, giving viewers the opportunity to create their own views, having before them the arguments of both. / U političkom magazinu promocija kulture dijaloga, i o aktuelnim temama društveno-političke zbilje. Kredibilni gosti iznose svoja, često suprotna mišljenja, dajući gledateljima priliku da, imajući pred sobom agumente i jednih i drugih, kreiraju vlastite stavove.

programme.title: Don't leave me / Ne ostavljaj me
programme.desc: The investigation focuses on Pietro Tomà of the Soter Foundation, whose ex-wife tells police that he behaved strangely towards the end of their marriage. A video of the boy has been posted online, but he is not listed among the missing teenagers known to police. Elena, disguised as Daniele, sneaks into Tomà's house and manages to copy files from his computer. The next morning, Tomà is visited by his accomplice, who is hiding the boy, and tells him that he cannot go on like this. Cast: Vittiria Puccini, Sarah Felberbaum, Duccio Gallorini, Massimo Rigo, Sergio Albelli, Maurizio Lombardi Director: Leonardo Fasoli, Maddalena Ravagli / Istraga se fokusira na Pietra Tomàa iz Fondacije Soter, čija bivša supruga policiji kaže da se čudno ponašao pred kraj njihovog braka. Na internetu je objavljen video dječaka, ali on nije naveden među nestalim tinejdžerima poznatim policiji. Elena, prerušena u Danielea, ušunja se u Tomàovu kuću i uspije kopirati datoteke s njegovog računara. Sljedećeg jutra, Tomàa posjećuje njegov saučesnik, koji skriva dječaka, i govori mu da ne može ovako nastaviti. Uloge: Vittiria Puccini, Sarah Felberbaum, Duccio Gallorini, Massimo Rigo, Sergio Albelli, Maurizio Lombardi Režija: Leonardo Fasoli, Maddalena Ravagli

The Adventures of Merlin - TV movie /2 episode/ / Приключенията на Мерлин - тв филм /2 епизод/
programme.desc: This 13-episode series tells the story of King Arthur's famous wizard Merlin. Even before it became known as the place of the Knights of the Round Table, the mythical city of Camelot was home to men, beasts and mythical creatures. However, in this world, magic is banned by the tyrant Uther Pedragón. When a young man named Merlin arrives in the city, he quickly makes many enemies because of the mystical and incredible powers he possesses. Among the enemies is Uther's heir, Prince Arthur. With the help of a doctor named Gaius, Merlin will be able to start using his talents not only to survive, but also to unlock the secrets of Camelot. The first thing that Merlin will discover is that his fate is closely connected with the young Arthur. / Този сериал от 13 епизода разказва историята на именития магьосник на крал Артур Мерлин. В митичния град Камелот още преди той да стане известен като мястото на рицарите на кръглата маса, живеят хора, зверове и митични създания. В този свят обаче магията е забранена от тиранина Утър Педрагон.Когато млад мъж на име Мерлин пристига в града, той бързо си спечелва много врагове заради мистичните и невероятни сили, които притежава. Сред враговете е и наследника на Утър принц Артур. С помощта на един лекар на име Гайъс Мерлин ще успее да започне да използва талантите си не само, за да оцелява, но и за да отключи тайните на Камелот.Първото нещо, което ще открие Мерлин, че съдбата му е близко свързана с младия Артур.

programme.desc: This 13-episode series tells the story of King Arthur's famous wizard Merlin. Even before it became known as the place of the Knights of the Round Table, the mythical city of Camelot was home to men, beasts and mythical creatures. However, in this world, magic is banned by the tyrant Uther Pedragón. When a young man named Merlin arrives in the city, he quickly makes many enemies because of the mystical and incredible powers he possesses. Among the enemies is Uther's heir, Prince Arthur. With the help of a doctor named Gaius, Merlin will be able to start using his talents not only to survive, but also to unlock the secrets of Camelot. The first thing that Merlin will discover is that his fate is closely connected with the young Arthur. / Този сериал от 13 епизода разказва историята на именития магьосник на крал Артур Мерлин. В митичния град Камелот още преди той да стане известен като мястото на рицарите на кръглата маса, живеят хора, зверове и митични създания. В този свят обаче магията е забранена от тиранина Утър Педрагон.Когато млад мъж на име Мерлин пристига в града, той бързо си спечелва много врагове заради мистичните и невероятни сили, които притежава. Сред враговете е и наследника на Утър принц Артур. С помощта на един лекар на име Гайъс Мерлин ще успее да започне да използва талантите си не само, за да оцелява, но и за да отключи тайните на Камелот.Първото нещо, което ще открие Мерлин, че съдбата му е близко свързана с младия Артур.

programme.title: Parenting in the animal world / Roditeljstvo u životinjskom svijetu
programme.desc: Parenthood - (E04, nature film, England, 2025) All life needs water to survive. But water is not always available and animal parents have to adapt to this issue without question. Dedication, perseverance and sheer courage are key to success in the freshwater world. In the Brazilian Amazon, thousands of turtles must predict the timing of the seasonal rains before laying their eggs. If they get it wrong, their young will drown underground, but if they get it right, it will be the start of one of the greatest spectacles on Earth as thousands of baby turtles follow their mothers' call to the water. In Namibia, watering holes provide a reliable source for the desert life of male South African saja. He must choose wisely the moment of decision in which to take water for his birds. If he makes a mistake in one second, he will end up in the claws of a predator. Some animal parents try to turn the power of water to their advantage. In the Caribbean, a flounder called a tri-tri diverts an underwater current to supply oxygen to its eggs. But before the eggs are laid, a once-in-a-lifetime storm sweeps him and everything he's made downstream. You have to make it over three hundred meters of waterfalls to get another chance for parenthood. In the wetlands of Florida, the clever swamp canary uses the power of its bite to pull its young out of danger in a matter of seconds. For some, it seems that the search for water never ends. In drought-stricken Kenya, an elephant and her family must share the remaining water with humans until the rains begin. And when it rains, the water is so violent that it can become deadly. With climate change, the movement of fresh water is increasingly difficult to predict. Humans and wildlife are adapting to changing freshwater flows, but we may choose to give the next generation a future where freshwater is a more reliable factor. R.: Hugh Wilson St.: Sir David Attenborough (Narrator)... / Parenthood - (E04, prirod. film, Engleska, 2025) Sav život treba vodu da bi opstao. No voda nije stalno dostupna i roditelji životinja moraju se bespogovorno prilagođavati tom pitanju. Predanost, ustrajnost i puka hrabrost ključni su za uspjeh u slatkovodnom svijetu. U brazilskoj Amazoniji tisuće kornjača moraju predvidjeti vrijeme sezonskih kiša prije nego što polože jaja. Ako pogriješe, njihov će se pomladak utopiti pod zemljom, ali ako dobro pogode, bit će to početak jednog od najvećih spektakala na Zemlji jer tisuće mladunaca kornjača slijede poziv svojih majki u vodu. U Namibiji pojilišta pružaju pouzdan izvor za pustinjski život mužjaka južnoafričke sadže. Mora mudro odabrati trenutak odluke u kojem će uzeti vodu za svoje ptiće. Pogriješi li za jednu sekundu, završit će u pandžama grabljivice. Neki životinjski roditelji pokušavaju okrenuti snagu vode u svoju korist. Na Karibima, glavoč zvan tri-tri skreće podvodnu struju za dovod kisika svojim jajašcima. No prije nego što su jajašca i položena, oluja koja se događa jednom u životu odnese nizvodno i njega i sve što je izradio. Mora se uspeti preko tristo metara slapova da bi dobio još jednu priliku za roditeljstvo. U močvarnim staništima Floride pametni močvarni kanarinac koristi se snagom zalogaja da izvuče svoju mladunce iz ralja opasnosti u trenutku kad je sve pitanje sekundi. Nekima se čini da potraga za vodom nikad ne prestaje. U sušom pogođenoj Keniji slonica i njezina obitelj moraju dijeliti preostalu vodu s ljudima dok ne počnu kiše. A kad kiša padne, voda je toliko silovita da može postati smrtonosna. Promjenom klime kretanja slatke vode sve je teže predvidjeti. Ljudi i divlje životinje prilagođavaju se promjenjivim slatkovodnim tokovima, ali možda odlučimo pružiti sljedećem naraštaju budućnost u kojoj će slatka voda biti pouzdaniji čimbenik. R.: Hugh Wilson Ul.: Sir David Attenborough (Narrator)...

programme.title: Pursuit / Potjera
programme.desc: Potjera - (quiz show, Croatia) In Potjera, four contestants answer general knowledge questions and in the process build tactics that can lead them to the final round. But the Hunter stands in their way. In an exciting game of knowledge and speed, this unusual opponent tries to knock them out one by one and send them home empty-handed. The chase is not just a quiz - it's also a race where the contestants have to escape the Hunter. Will he be able to keep a step or two ahead of him? Can the chosen four win, no matter how shrewd their opponent is?... / Potjera - (kviz show, Hrvatska) U Potjeri četiri natjecatelja odgovaraju na pitanja općeg znanja i pritom grade taktiku koja ih može dovesti do finalnog kruga. No na putu im stoji Lovac. Taj neuobičajeni protivnik u uzbudljivoj igri znanja i brzine pokušava jednog po jednog izbaciti iz igre i poslati ih kući praznih ruku. Potjera nije samo kviz - ona je i utrka u kojoj natjecatelji moraju pobjeći Lovcu. Hoće li uspjeti zadržati korak-dva prednosti pred njim? Može li četvero izabranih pobijediti, ma koliko oštrouman bio njihov protivnik?...

programme.title: The Promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La promesa - (S04, E49, Drama, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is in turmoil, life at the noble estate of La Promesa owned by the Luján family could not be more peaceful - or so it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish high society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján, and the daughter of one of the wealthiest families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is an arranged marriage that should save the family from financial ruin. Meanwhile, the enigmatic young Jana (20) starts working on La Promesa and helps as a maid during the wedding preparations. While wandering around the building, he meets Manuel (23), the count's youngest son and Tomás' half-brother. It is a meeting that she will not be able to forget... On the day of the wedding, the countess cannot hide her displeasure since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction grows more and more, and after her outburst of anger, Jana is fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel puts on a show with his biplane and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is cut short when he loses control and crashes not far from the estate. Jana saw what happened and rushed to the scene of the accident to save Manuel. The count offers Jana a generous reward as a sign of gratitude, but she only asks to be put back to work. The family doesn't know it, but Jana has always had a plan to avenge the murder of her mother, which happened 15 years ago, and she wants to find her younger brother, who was kidnapped the same night. The only clue that Jana has leads to the magnificent building of La Promesa, where she wants to infiltrate and find the killer... But also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day, another unfortunate event brings turmoil to the estate. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined to find the killer. All evidence points to Jana because she is the last person Tomás spoke to before his death. R.: Miguel Cond... / La promesa - (S04, E49, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: The dance of fate / Ples sudbine
programme.desc: Alem da Ilusao - (E21, telenovela, Brazil, 2022) Joaquim realizes his plan to destroy a fashion show. He begs Onofre for help to slow down the production of fabric in the factory. Mariana is a high-ranking member of the Brazilian Aid Legion, and steals the donated items for herself. However, Arminda finds out and hatches a plan with Julinha to expose her. With the arrival of the first lady in town, Mariana falls for Julina's trick and exposes her in front of Mrs. Darci Vargas. During the fashion show, Yedda, a friend of Eugenio's ex-fiancée, reveals to him that he has never been cheated on. Matias goes crazy with jealousy when he hears that Violeta and Eugenio got married. Joaquim turns off the lights in the theater to ruin the fashion show, but Rafael manages the situation. Isadora finally surrenders to the love she feels and kisses Rafael. Eugenio kisses Violeta. Matias reveals Heloís's secret. Director: Luiz Henrique Rios Street: Antonio Calloni (Matias Tapajos), Paloma Duarte (Heloísa Camargo), Malu Galli (Violeta Camargo Tapajos), Larissa Manoela (Isadora Camargo Tapajos / Elisa Camargo Tapajos), Danilo Mesquita (Joaquim)... / Alem da Ilusao - (E21, telenovela, Brazil, 2022) Joaquim ostvari svoj plan kojim želi uništiti modnu reviju. Moli Onofrea za pomoć kako bi usporio proizvodnju tkanine u tvornici. Mariana je visokopozicionirana u Brazilskoj legiji za pomoć, i ukrade donirane stvari za sebe. Međutim, Arminda to sazna i kuje plan sa Julinhom kako bi je razotkrile. Dolaskom prve dame u grad, Mariana nasjedne na Julinhinu smicalicu i razotkriju je pred gđom Darci Vargas. Tijekom modne revije, Yedda, prijateljica Eugeniove bivše zaručnice otkrije mu da on nikad nije bio prevaren. Matias poludi od ljubomore kad čuje da su se Violeta i Eugenio vjenčali. Joaquim gasi svjetla u kazalištu kako bi uništio modnu reviju, ali Rafael se snađe u toj situaciji. Isadora se konačno prepusti ljubavi koju osjeća i poljubi Rafaela. Eugenio poljubi Violetu. Matias oda Heloísinu tajnu. R.: Luiz Henrique Rios Ul.: Antonio Calloni (Matias Tapajos), Paloma Duarte (Heloísa Camargo), Malu Galli (Violeta Camargo Tapajos), Larissa Manoela (Isadora Camargo Tapajos / Elisa Camargo Tapajos), Danilo Mesquita (Joaquim)...

programme.title: Cocoa / Cacau
programme.desc: Cacao - (S02, E17, drama series, Portugal, 2024) Telenovela tells the life of a beautiful, brave and unrestrained 22-year-old girl, Cacau, who lives on the estate where her Portuguese parents, Joaquim and Filomena, live. They are the hosts and trusted people of the rich boss Justin Vaz Pereira, also Portuguese, who is old and sick, so he follows the business from Portugal. Cacau's best friends are Pitty and Guto who help her realize the idea that Brazil tastes the best chocolate - spicy chocolate from Itacare. Cacau works in a chocolate factory, and spends his free time in the warm sea of ​​Bahia, where he likes to surf. She is a gifted chocolate maker, and her biggest dream is to get an international diploma in confectionery and chocolate skills. However, she believes that it is unattainable for her because her family does not have the necessary money for this very expensive course. Director: Ricardo Carreira Street: Matilde Reymao (Cacau), Jose Condessa (Tiago), Alexandra Lencastre (Simone de Gusmao), Paulo Pires (Salomao), Ines Castel-Branco (Lala)... / Cacao - (S02, E17, igrana serija, Portugal, 2024) Telenovela govori o životu lijepe, hrabre i neobuzdane 22-godišnje djevojke Cacau koja živi na imanju na kojemu su njezini roditelji Portugalci, Joaquim i Filomena. Oni su domaćini i ljudi od povjerenja bogatoga gazde Justina Vaza Pereire, također Portugalca, koji je star i bolestan, pa prati poslovanje iz Portugala. Najbolji prijatelji Cacau su Pitty i Guto koji joj pomažu ostvariti zamisao da Brazil kuša najbolju čokoladu - pikantnu čokoladu iz Itacarea. Cacau radi u tvornici čokolade, a slobodno vrijeme provodi u toplom moru Bahije gdje voli surfati. Nadarena je proizvođačica čokolade, a najveći joj je san dobiti međunarodnu diplomu iz slastičarstva i čokoladnih vještina. Ipak vjeruje da joj je to nedostižno jer njezina obitelj nema potreban novac za taj vrlo skup tečaj. R.: Ricardo Carreira Ul.: Matilde Reymao (Cacau), Jose Condessa (Tiago), Alexandra Lencastre (Simone de Gusmao), Paulo Pires (Salomao), Ines Castel-Branco (Lala)...

programme.desc: Kod nas doma - (talk show, Croatia, 2025) The daily show Kod nas doma talks about current topics and events in our country and in the world every weekday afternoon. It brings the stories of inspiring people and follows important social events, fashion shows and premieres. In the pleasant atmosphere of the studio, the presenters discuss interesting topics with public figures and experts... / Kod nas doma - (talk show, Hrvatska, 2025) Dnevna emisija Kod nas doma svaki radni dan poslijepodne progovara o aktualnim temama i zbivanjima kod nas i u svijetu. Donosi priče inspirativnih ljudi i prate važne društvene događaje, modne revije i premijere. U ugodnoj atmosferi studija s javnim osobama i stručnjacima voditelji razgovaraju o zanimljivim temama...

programme.desc: Sketch for a portrait - (artistic portrait series, Croatia) In the form of a short documentary film, the show presents authors important to Croatian history and culture... / Skica za portret - (serijal umj. portr., Hrvatska) U formi kratkog dokumentarnog filma emisija predstavlja autore važne za hrvatsku povijest i kulturu...

programme.title: The third age / Treća dob
programme.desc: The third age - (educational program, Croatia) Retirement causes joy, excitement, fear, uncertainty... all that, and even a lot more confusion in the head. This is often witnessed by those who leave the world of work and face a new period of life. Can and how can we prepare for this new life chapter? Of course, those who have already experienced it can teach us this best. One of them is the retired doctor Mira Lončar Dušek, who wrote a book about the "pension project", the story of which was written by Branimira Volf Milunović. And what are the conditions for a less stressful retirement, do we know what memory optimism is and what we can do to make retirement as pleasant as possible, we will talk with psychologist Lovorka Brajković... / Treća dob - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) Radost, uzbuđenje, strah, neizvjesnost... sve to, pa i puno više zbrke u glavi, izaziva odlazak u mirovinu. Svjedoče nam to često oni koji napuštaju svijet rada i suočavaju se s novim razdobljem života. Možemo li se i kako pripremiti na to novo životno poglavlje? Tomu nas, naravno, mogu najbolje poučiti oni koji su to već iskusili. Jedna od njih je i umirovljena liječnica Mira Lončar Dušek, koja je o "projektu mirovina" napisala knjigu, o kojoj je priču napravila Branimira Volf Milunović. A koji su uvjeti za manje stresan odlazak u mirovinu, znamo li što je optimizam pamćenja i što sami možemo napraviti da mirovina bude što ugodnija, razgovarat ćemo s psihologinjom Lovorkom Brajković...

programme.title: Dr. Beck / Dr. Beck
programme.desc: dr. Beck - (show magazine, Croatia) Botox is best known for its aesthetic application, but it is much more than that. From migraines to muscle spasms, from sweating to urology - Botox also helps people as a medicine. How it works and when it is used, we will find out in today's show from urologist Dr. Anđel Mojsović, neurologist Assoc. Ph.D. Hrvoje Budinčević and otorhinolaryngologist Assoc. Ph.D. Krešimir Gršić. Leader: Natko Beck, MD. Producer: Vesna Luković Žarn Editor: Sandra Pavković Project editor: Gordana Škaljac Narančić Producer: Dario Jakiša... / Dr. Beck - (show magazin, Hrvatska) Botoks je najpoznatiji po svojoj estetskoj primjeni, ali je i puno više od toga. Od migrena do spazma mišića, od znojenja do urologije - botoks pomaže ljudima i kao lijek. Kako funkcionira i kada se koristi doznat ćemo u današnjoj emisiji od urologa dr. Anđela Mojsovića, neurologa doc. dr. sc. Hrvoja Budinčevića i otorinolaringologa doc. dr. sc. Krešimira Gršića. Voditelj: Natko Beck, dr. med. Realizatorica: Vesna Luković Žarn Urednica: Sandra Pavković Urednica projekta: Gordana Škaljac Narančić Producent: Dario Jakiša...

programme.title: Lidia's kitchen / Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Lidia's Kitchen - (S11, E20, doc series, USA, 2024) Some Italian dishes are too good for Lidia to pass up. For example, a version of bruschetta with mussels, inspired by Lidia's favorite restaurant on the beach in Fiumicino. Afterwards, Lorenzo will stop by for an olive oil tasting. At the end, Lidia will prepare a dish from the coast in Amalfi - spaghetti in cream sauce and lemon juice. Lidia fell in love with these dishes at the first bite, so she hopes that we will too. Director: Erika Heymann Street: Lorenzo Manuali (Self), Erminia Motika (Self)... / Lidias Kitchen - (S11, E20, dok. serija, SAD, 2024) Neka talijanska jela predobra su da ih Lidia ne bi podijelila s drugima. Primjerice, inačica brusketa s dagnjama, nadahnuta Lidijinim najdražim restoranom na plaži u Fiumicinu. Potom će Lorenzo svratiti na degustaciju maslinova ulja. Lidia će na kraju pripremiti jelo s obale u Amalfiju - špagete u umaku od vrhnja i limunova soka. Lidia se u ova jela zaljubila na prvi zalogaj pa se nada da ćemo se i mi. R.: Erika Heymann Ul.: Lorenzo Manuali (Self), Erminia Motika (Self)...

programme.title: Golden League / Zlatna liga
programme.desc: Zlatna liga - (educational program, Croatia) Two giants are visiting us. Both are academics and bards of Croatian architecture. We are honored to host Andrija Mutnjaković and Nikola Bašić in the Golden League! Half an hour is absolutely not enough for their huge oeuvre and incredible contribution to Croatian architecture, that's why in the conversation we will only touch on some of their works, such as the Trešnja Theatre, the library in Priština or... the Zadar sea organ and Salutation to the Sun, as well as Kornati crosses. Of course, along with these two architectural giants, we will touch on urbanism as a burning problem in Croatia. R.: Mladen Šimunov... / Zlatna liga - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) U goste nam dolaze dvojica velikana. Obojica su akademici i bardovi hrvatske arhitekture. Čast nam je u Zlatnoj ligi ugostiti Andriju Mutnjakovića i Nikolu Bašića! Pola sata je apsolutno nedostatno za njihov golemi opus i nevjerojatan doprinos hrvatskoj arhitekturi, zato ćemo se u razgovoru dotaknuti samo nekih od njihovih djela, poput Kazališta Trešnja, biblioteke u Prištini ili... zadarskih morskih orgulja i Pozdrava Suncu, ali i kornatskih križeva. Naravno, uz ovakva dva arhitektonska velikana, dotaknut ćemo se urbanizma kao gorućeg problema u Hrvatskoj. R.: Mladen Šimunov...

programme.title: Lidia's kitchen / Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Lidias Kitchen - (S11, E21, doc. series, USA, 2024) Through 26 episodes, the series follows Lidia Bastianich on another culinary journey full of discoveries. Join Lidia, who will prepare simple, seasonal and economical dishes with lots of charm, trust and love. It will show viewers that they can find inspiration in their roots, that they should be spontaneous and that they should cultivate a sense of home in the kitchen. With a wealth of tips and methods that are the result of years of experience in the kitchen and at the family table, Lidia will translate her passion for teaching into a fun and credible curriculum that encompasses kitchen wisdom. As Lidia says, "feeding yourself, your family and friends is one of the most important things in life". Famous American chef, restaurant owner, author of several cooking books, author of culinary series Lidia Bastianich is a native of Croatia, more precisely from Pula. Director: Erika Heymann Ul.: Daniela Zappoli (Self), Monica Zappoli (Self), Erminia Motika (Self)... / Lidias Kitchen - (S11, E21, dok. serija, SAD, 2024) Serija kroz 26 nastavaka prati Lidiju Bastianich na još jednom kulinarskom putovanju punom otkrića. Pridružite se Lidiji koja će pripremati jednostavna, sezonska i ekonomična jela s puno čara, pouzdanja i ljubavi. Pokazat će gledateljima da nadahnuće mogu pronaći u svojim korijenima, da trebaju biti spontani i da u kuhinji trebaju njegovati osjećaj doma. Uz bogatstvo savjeta i metoda koji su rezultat dugogodišnjeg iskustva u kuhinji i za obiteljskim stolom, Lidia će svoju strast prema poučavanju pretočiti u zabavan i vjerodostojan nastavni plan i program koji obuhvaća kuhinjsku mudrost. Kao što Lidia kaže, "hraniti sebe, svoju obitelj i prijatelje jedna je od najvažnijih stvari u životu". Poznata američka kuharica, vlasnica restorana, autorica nekoliko knjiga o kuhanju, autorica kulinarskih serija Lidia Bastianich rodom je iz Hrvatske, točnije iz Pule. R.: Erika Heymann Ul.: Daniela Zappoli (Self), Monica Zappoli (Self), Erminia Motika (Self)...

programme.title: Dr. Beck / Dr. Beck
programme.desc: dr. Beck - (show magazine, Croatia) Staying healthy - is it a matter of choice or circumstances? Are we destined for some diseases? Can we change outcomes? Ljubica Odak, dr. Laura Vidović i nutricionistica dr. sc. Eva Pavić. Voditelj: Natko Beck, dr. med. programme.title: The Promise / La Promesa
programme.desc: La promesa - (S04, E50, Drama Series, Spain, 2024) In 1913, while Europe is in turmoil, life at the noble estate of La Promesa owned by the Luján family could not be more peaceful - or so it seems. The family is preparing to celebrate one of the most important events in Spanish high society - the wedding of Tomás, the eldest son of Count Luján, and the daughter of one of the wealthiest families in the country. However, the Luján family knows that this is an arranged marriage that should save the family from financial ruin. Meanwhile, the enigmatic young Jana (20) starts working on La Promesa and helps as a maid during the wedding preparations. While wandering around the building, he meets Manuel (23), the count's youngest son and Tomás' half-brother. It is a meeting that she will not be able to forget... On the day of the wedding, the countess cannot hide her displeasure since she wanted the groom to actually be her son Manuel. Her dissatisfaction grows more and more, and after her outburst of anger, Jana is fired. During the wedding, everything goes according to plan until Manuel puts on a show with his biplane and shows incredible acrobatic skills, and the celebration is cut short when he loses control and crashes not far from the estate. Jana saw what happened and rushed to the scene of the accident to save Manuel. The count offers Jana a generous reward as a sign of gratitude, but she only asks to be put back to work. The family doesn't know it, but Jana has always had a plan to avenge the murder of her mother, which happened 15 years ago, and she wants to find her younger brother, who was kidnapped the same night. The only clue that Jana has leads to the magnificent building of La Promesa, where she wants to infiltrate and find the killer... But also find love in Manuel's embrace. The next day, another unfortunate event brings turmoil to the estate. Tomás was found dead. Sergeant Conrado, a member of the Civil Guard, is determined to find the killer. All evidence points to Jana because she is the last person Tomás spoke to before his death. R.: Miguel Cond... / La promesa - (S04, E50, igrana serija, Španjolska, 2024) Godine 1913., dok Europom vladaju nemiri, život na plemićkom imanju La Promesa u vlasništvu obitelji Luján ne može biti mirniji - bar se tako čini. Obitelj se priprema za proslavu jednog od najvažnijih događaja u španjolskom viskom društvu - vjenčanje Tomása, najstarijeg sina grofa Lujána i kćeri jedne od najimućnijih obitelji u zemlji. Međutim, obitelj Luján zna kako je ovo ugovoreni brak koji bi obitelj trebao spasiti od financijske propasti. U međuvremenu, zagonetna mlada Jana (20) počinje raditi na La Promesi te kao sluškinja pomaže tijekom priprema za vjenčanje. Dok luta zdanjem, susreće Manuela (23) grofova najmlađeg sina i Tomásova polubrata. Susret je to koji neće moći zaboraviti... Grofica na dan vjenčanja ne može skriti svoje nezadovoljstvo budući da je ona htjela da mladoženja zapravo bude njezin sin Manuel. Njezino nezadovoljstvo sve više raste, a nakon njezina ispada bijesa, Jana dobiva otkaz. Tijekom vjenčanja sve ide po planu sve dok Manuel ne izvede predstavu sa svojim avionom dvokrilcem te pokaže nevjerojatne akrobatske vještine, a slavlje se prekida kad izgubi kontrolu i sruši se nedaleko od imanja. Jana je vidjela što se dogodilo te pohita na mjesto nesreće kako bi spasila Manuela. Grof ponudi Jani velikodušnu nagradu u znak zahvalnosti, ali ona zatraži samo da je vrate na posao. Obitelj to ne zna, ali Jana cijelo vrijeme ima plan osvetiti ubojstvo svoje majke koje se dogodilo prije 15 godina te želi pronaći svog mlađeg brata koji je iste večeri otet. Jedini trag koji Jana ima vodi je do velebnog zdanja La Promesa u koje se želi infiltrirati te pronaći ubojicu... Ali i naći ljubav u Manuelovom zagrljaju. Idućeg dana još jedan nesretni događaj unese pomutnju na imanje. Tomás je pronađen mrtav. Narednik Conrado, pripadnik civilne garde, odlučan je u svom naumu da pronađe ubojicu. Svi dokazi upućuju na Janu jer ona je posljednja osoba s kojom je Tomás prije smrti razgovarao. R.: Miguel Cond...

programme.title: In Suzy's kitchen / U kuhinji kod Suzy
programme.desc: In the kitchen at Suzy's - (educational program, Croatia) Suzy Josipović let us into her home where she prepares a simple dish in front of the camera and shares her culinary knowledge and experience with us... / U kuhinji kod Suzy - (obrazovni program, Hrvatska) Suzy Josipović pustila nas je u svoj dom gdje u kuhinji ispred kamera sprema jednostavno jelo te dijeli s nama svoje kulinarsko znanje i iskustvo...

programme.title: Dulum of the earth / Dulum zemlje
programme.desc: Dulum zemlje - (S04, E04, educational program, Croatia, 2025) The Knežević family from Šiškovci has been nurturing beekeeping for four generations. Their story was not without challenges, the head of the family survived a heart attack twice and returned to his work each time. Today, the whole family works side by side, producing top quality honey and at the same time contributing to the preservation of nature and biodiversity. The episode tells a story about perseverance, togetherness and love for work that overcomes obstacles. Director: Filip Filković... / Dulum zemlje - (S04, E04, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) Obitelj Knežević iz Šiškovaca već četiri generacije njeguje pčelarstvo. Njihova priča nije bila bez izazova, glava obitelji dvaput je preživio infarkt i svaki put se vraćao svom poslu. Danas cijela obitelj radi rame uz rame, proizvodeći vrhunski med i istodobno pridonoseći očuvanju prirode i biodiverziteta. Epizoda donosi priču o ustrajnosti, zajedništvu i ljubavi prema poslu koji nadilazi prepreke. R.: Filip Filković...

programme.title: Our little parties / Naše male fešte
programme.desc: Our little festivities - (E05, art program, Croatia, 2024) The episode takes us to Vinkovci, where the rich history of this town, famous for the Roman emperors Valens and Valentinian, is celebrated. Through a dynamic presentation of the Roman festival, we follow the preparations and activities of visitors and organizers, from pottery workshops to the spectacular parade of legionnaires and gladiator fights. The culmination of the day is the Roman feast, where local restaurateurs recreate Roman delicacies, and it ends under the stars, with special screenings of chivalric films and a sense of community. Director: Goran Ribarić... / Naše male fešte - (E05, umjetnički program, Hrvatska, 2024) Epizoda nas vodi u Vinkovce, gdje se slavi bogata povijest ovog grada, poznatog po rimskim carevima Valensu i Valentinijanu. Kroz dinamičan prikaz Rimske fešte, pratimo pripreme i aktivnosti posjetitelja i organizatora, od radionica lončarstva do spektakularnog mimohoda legionara i borbi gladijatora. Kulminacija dana je Rimska gozba, gdje lokalni ugostitelji rekonstruiraju rimske delicije, a završava pod zvijezdama, s posebnim prikazima viteških filmova i osjećajem zajedništva. R.: Goran Ribarić...

programme.title: Ben Fogle - Wild People / Ben Fogle - Ljudi od divljine
programme.desc: Ben Fogle: New Lives in the Wild - (S09, E07, Education, England, 2022) Ben travels to the Arizona desert where he meets Dee, a retired woman who lives a nomadic life. She converted a military truck into a cozy house for living, and she documents her adventures on YouTube under the name "Box Van Dee". As he follows Dee in his car, Ben will experience firsthand what it's like to live in a small vehicle in the middle of the desert. Together they will solve the problems of food preparation, water collection, waste disposal and solar panel repair. Ben will find out about Dee's creative activities and how she makes friends. Director: Dimitri Collingridge... / Ben Fogle: New Lives in the Wild - (S09, E07, obrazovni program, Engleska, 2022) Ben putuje u pustinju u Arizoni gdje će upoznati Dee - umirovljenicu koja živi nomadskim životom. Vojni kamion preuredila je u ugodnu kućicu za stanovanje, a svoje pustolovine dokumentira na You Tubeu pod imenom "Box Van Dee". Dok bude automobilom slijedio Dee, Ben će iz prve ruke iskusiti kako je to živjeti u malom vozilu usred pustinje. Zajedno će rješavati probleme pripreme jela, skupljanja vode, bacanja otpada i popravka solarnih panela. Ben će saznati s kojim se kreativnim aktivnostima Dee bavi i kako nalazi prijatelje. R.: Dimitri Collingridge...

programme.title: Don't forget to leave a review / Ne zaboravite ostaviti recenziju
programme.desc: Don't forget to leave a review - (E04, tourist program, Croatia, 2025) What happens in the virtual world rarely stays there. For a once hidden heavenly place like Blue Cave, the echo in reality means that after a series of reviews and likes, it will be at the top of the list of top five undiscovered destinations of Croatian islands in a flash. But when the hidden paradise becomes only a backdrop for selfies, and the sea - a soup of tourists - there is a fine line between discovery and destruction. Can our fantastic natural beauty survive its own popularity if every star has consequences? R.: Ivan Grgur... / Ne zaboravite ostaviti recenziju - (E04, turistički program, Hrvatska, 2025) Ono što se dogodi u virtualnom svijetu, rijetko ondje i ostane. Za nekada skriveno rajsko mjesto poput Modre špilje, odjek u stvarnosti znači da će nakon niza recenzija i lajkova, munjevito biti na vrhu liste top pet neotkrivenih destinacija hrvatskih otoka. No kada skriveni raj postane tek kulisa za selfije, a more - juha od turista - tanka je granica između otkrivanja i uništavanja. Mogu li naše fantastične prirodne ljepote preživjeti vlastitu popularnost ako svaka zvjezdica ima posljedice? R.: Ivan Grgur...

programme.desc: Police stories - (E04, educational program, Croatia, 2025) This episode brings us the untold story of a mine in the port of Rijeka that filled the newspaper columns. R.: Hrvoje Mabić... / Policijske priče - (E04, obrazovni program, Hrvatska, 2025) Neispričanu priču o mini u luci Rijeka koja je punila novinske stupce donosi nam ova epizoda. Iz prve ruke doznajte kako se osjećaju pirotehničari u trenutku kada moraju zaroniti u mulj i naći se licem u lice s eksplozivnom napravom. R.: Hrvoje Mabić...

Director: Danis Tanović Ul.: Feđa Štukan (Edib), Boris Ler (Mido), Ida Keskić (Ajla), Vedrana Božinović (Selma), Mario Knezović (Senci)... / Kotlina - (S01, E02, igrana serija, Bosna i Hercegovina, 2022) Nakon što leš nestane iz mrtvačnice, Edib i Mido pokušavaju otkriti identitet žrtve slijedeći razne tragove. Ajla i dalje ne uspijeva obaviti intervju sa Selmom, no dolazi do intrigantnih informacija o tajnim planovima vezanim za muzej. Senči, koristeći stare kriminalne veze, pokušava doći do Smajlija. programme.title: A conversation with a reason / Razgovor s razlogom
programme.desc: Conversation with a reason - (art program, Croatia) The guest of Conversation with a reason is the director of the Zagreb Youth Theater Snježana Abramović Milković. We talk about the role played by boards that mean life in society. Should provocation and criticism be avoided or encouraged in the theater? Why is it important for the theater to be brave, to be a space of freedom and truth? Why does it have to question social movements and political power? Why should you feel for a person? Can we purify traumas and unresolved relationships through theater? Why is international cooperation important to ZKM? From drama to dance, from provocation to artistic freedom, there are many reasons to talk to Snježana Abramović Milković. R.: Siniša Hajduk... / Razgovor s razlogom - (umjetnički program, Hrvatska) Gošća Razgovora s razlogom je ravnateljica Zagrebačkog kazališta mladih Snježana Abramović Milković. Razgovaramo o ulozi koju u društvu igraju daske koje život znače. Treba li u kazalištu izbjegavati provokaciju i kritiku ili ih poticati? Zašto je važno da kazalište bude hrabro, da bude prostor slobode i istine? Zašto mora preispitivati društvena kretanja i političku moć? Zašto treba imati osjećaj za čovjeka? Možemo li kroz kazalište pročistiti traume i neriješene odnose? Zašto je ZKM-u važna međunarodna suradnja? Od drame do plesa od provokacije do umjetničke slobode, mnogo je razloga za razgovor sa Snježanom Abramović Milković. R.: Siniša Hajduk...

programme.title: Legends of the Earth / Legende o Zemlji
programme.desc: Terre de legendes - (E04, nature film, France, 2024) According to ancient philosophy, four basic elements interact to create our planet. One of them is air. This invisible and untouchable element has created amazing phenomena such as powerful tornadoes in the USA or wild storms that hit the Irish coast, but also the wonderful aurora borealis in the Finnish sky. In this sequel, legends and science help explain the origin and beauty of these unusual landscapes. R.: Lucas Allain... / Terre de legendes - (E04, prirod. film, Francuska, 2024) Prema antičkoj filozofiji, četiri osnovna elementa međudjelovanjem stvaraju naš planet. Jedan je od njih zrak. Taj nevidljivi i nedodirljivi element stvorio je začuđujuće pojave poput snažnih tornada u SAD-u ili divljih oluja koje pogađaju irsku obalu, ali i divnu polarnu svjetlost na finskom nebu. U ovom nastavku legende i znanost pomažu objasniti postanak i ljepotu tih neobičnih krajolika. R.: Lucas Allain...

programme.title: The dance of fate / Ples sudbine
programme.desc: Alem da Ilusao - (E22, telenovela, Brazil, 2022) Matias recalls the day Heloísa gave herself to him as a very young girl. He reveals that he remembers that Heloís' lost daughter is also his. Mrs. Felicidade finds a new relationship with Onofre and worries about firing him after it is revealed that he deliberately sabotaged the factory for money. Isadora breaks off her engagement with Joaquim, which makes him angry. Isadora tells Violeta that she has finally given in to the love she feels for Rafael. Mariana blackmails Ms. Julinha into rehiring her at the Brazilian Aid Legion. Eugenio and Violeta kiss again and he confesses that he is in love with her. Julinha cannot resist the temptation and takes the money that Darca gave to the Brazilian Legion. He gambled with him and lost. Julinha's mother suddenly appears and settles in Constantin's house. Olívia tells Father Tenori that she is in love with him. Joaquim finds a hit man who should kill Rafael. Otkrije da se sjeća kako je Heloísina izgubljena kći također i njegova. Gđa Felicidade nađe novi čunak s Onofreom i zabrine se hoće li ga otpustiti nakon što se otkrije da je on namjerno sabotirao tvornicu zbog novca. programme.title: Cultural heritage / Kulturna baština
programme.desc: Cultural heritage - (doc. series, Croatia, 2015) Ivančica or Ivanščica, also known as Očura in older literature, is the highest mountain in Croatian Zagorje. On its slopes, especially the southern ones, after the invasion of the Tatars in the middle of the 13th century, but also later during the war with the Ottomans, fortresses and noble towns were built, which functioned mainly until the 17th century, when they were abandoned and fell into oblivion. Researchers of the past of noble towns have been warning for more than a century about their importance and the need for the places where generations of noble families who created Croatian history were born, married and died to be better known, restored or at least preserved in their current state. So far, only a few have been so lucky. R.: Mirela Sakoman... / Kulturna baština - (dok. serija, Hrvatska, 2015) Ivančica ili Ivanščica, u starijoj literaturi poznata i kao Očura, najviša je planina u Hrvatskom zagorju. Po njezinim se padinama, osobito južnima, grade nakon provale Tatara sredinom 13. stojeća ali i poslije u doba rata s Osmanlijama - utvrde, plemićki gradovi koji funkcioniraju uglavnom do u 17. stoljeće kad se napuštaju i padaju u zaborav. Istraživači prošlosti plemićkih gradova već više od stoljeća upozoravaju na njihovu važnost i potrebu da se mjesta gdje su se rađale, ženile i umirale generacije plemićkih rodova koji su stvarali hrvatsku povijest bolje upoznaju, obnove ili barem konzerviraju u svom sadašnjem stanju. Dosad su samo rijetki bili te sreće. R.: Mirela Sakoman...

programme.title: Lidia's kitchen / Lidijina kuhinja
programme.desc: Lidias Kitchen - (S11, E21, doc. series, USA, 2024) Through 26 episodes, the series follows Lidia Bastianich on another culinary journey full of discoveries. Join Lidia, who will prepare simple, seasonal and economical dishes with lots of charm, trust and love. It will show viewers that they can find inspiration in their roots, that they should be spontaneous and that they should cultivate a sense of home in the kitchen. With a wealth of tips and methods that are the result of years of experience in the kitchen and at the family table, Lidia will translate her passion for teaching into a fun and credible curriculum that encompasses kitchen wisdom. As Lidia says, "feeding yourself, your family and friends is one of the most important things in life". Famous American chef, restaurant owner, author of several cooking books, author of culinary series Lidia Bastianich is a native of Croatia, more precisely from Pula. Director: Erika Heymann Ul.: Daniela Zappoli (Self), Monica Zappoli (Self), Erminia Motika (Self)... / Lidias Kitchen - (S11, E21, dok. serija, SAD, 2024) Serija kroz 26 nastavaka prati Lidiju Bastianich na još jednom kulinarskom putovanju punom otkrića. Pridružite se Lidiji koja će pripremati jednostavna, sezonska i ekonomična jela s puno čara, pouzdanja i ljubavi. Pokazat će gledateljima da nadahnuće mogu pronaći u svojim korijenima, da trebaju biti spontani i da u kuhinji trebaju njegovati osjećaj doma. Uz bogatstvo savjeta i metoda koji su rezultat dugogodišnjeg iskustva u kuhinji i za obiteljskim stolom, Lidia će svoju strast prema poučavanju pretočiti u zabavan i vjerodostojan nastavni plan i program koji obuhvaća kuhinjsku mudrost. Kao što Lidia kaže, "hraniti sebe, svoju obitelj i prijatelje jedna je od najvažnijih stvari u životu". Poznata američka kuharica, vlasnica restorana, autorica nekoliko knjiga o kuhanju, autorica kulinarskih serija Lidia Bastianich rodom je iz Hrvatske, točnije iz Pule. programme.title: Dr. Beck / Dr. Beck
programme.desc: dr. Beck - (show magazine, Croatia) The brain is the center of the nervous system and the most important organ for the human ability to think and most functions in the body. It has no pain receptors and therefore cannot feel pain, but any disease affecting that organ can be fatal. One of them is certainly meningitis, the secrets of which we reveal with infectious disease specialist Viktor Kotarski and virologist Vladimir Stevanović... / Dr. Beck - (show magazin, Hrvatska) Mozak je središte živčanog sustava i najvažniji organ za čovjekovu sposobnost razmišljanja i većinu funkcija u tijelu. Nema receptore za bol i zbog toga ne može osjetiti bol, no svaka bolest koja zahvati taj organ može biti fatalna. Jedna od njih svakako je meningitis čije tajne razotkrivamo s infektologom Viktorom Kotarskim i virologom Vladimirom Stevanovićem...
